panels.title: Core API availability
panels.description: Per service in a rolling 5-minute window. 2xx and 3xx are successful, 5xx are failures. Windows with no eligible requests have no series.

targets.expr:
1 - ((
sum by (app_service) (count_over_time(
  {service_name=~".+"} |= ".http.request"
  | cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
  | json cf_message="message"
  | line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
  | drop cf_message
  | json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", route="route", status="status"
  | __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
  | app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request|billing[.]http[.]request"
  | route=~"/(api/(v1|account)|internal/v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/v1/(health|readiness)"
  | status=~"5[0-9]{2}" | keep app_service
  [5m]
))
or (0 * sum by (app_service) (count_over_time(
  {service_name=~".+"} |= ".http.request"
  | cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
  | json cf_message="message"
  | line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
  | drop cf_message
  | json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", route="route", status="status"
  | __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
  | app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request|billing[.]http[.]request"
  | route=~"/(api/(v1|account)|internal/v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/v1/(health|readiness)"
  | status=~"[235][0-9]{2}" | keep app_service
  [5m]
)))
) / sum by (app_service) (count_over_time(
  {service_name=~".+"} |= ".http.request"
  | cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
  | json cf_message="message"
  | line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
  | drop cf_message
  | json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", route="route", status="status"
  | __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
  | app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request|billing[.]http[.]request"
  | route=~"/(api/(v1|account)|internal/v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/v1/(health|readiness)"
  | status=~"[235][0-9]{2}" | keep app_service
  [5m]
)))

panels.title: Core API requests per second
panels.description: Per service in a rolling 5-minute window. Includes client and server errors. Health and readiness are excluded.

targets.expr:
sum by (app_service) (rate(
  {service_name=~".+"} |= ".http.request"
  | cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
  | json cf_message="message"
  | line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
  | drop cf_message
  | json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", route="route"
  | __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
  | app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request|billing[.]http[.]request"
  | route=~"/(api/(v1|account)|internal/v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/v1/(health|readiness)"
  | keep app_service
  [5m]
))

panels.title: Core API latency by route (P50)
panels.description: 5-minute rolling median by service and route template. Includes unsuccessful requests.

targets.expr:
quantile_over_time(0.50,
  {service_name=~".+"} |= ".http.request"
  | cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
  | json cf_message="message"
  | line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
  | drop cf_message
  | json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", route="route", duration_ms="duration_ms"
  | __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
  | app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request|billing[.]http[.]request"
  | route=~"/(api/(v1|account)|internal/v1)/.+" | route!~"/api/v1/(health|readiness)"
  | keep app_service, route, duration_ms
  | unwrap duration_ms | __error__=""
  [5m]
) by (app_service, route)

panels.title: Top 10 client errors (4xx)
panels.description: Request count by service, HTTP status, and error code over the selected time range.

targets.expr:
topk(10, sum by (app_service, status, error_code) (count_over_time(
  {service_name=~".+"} |= ".http.request"
  | cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
  | json cf_message="message"
  | line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
  | drop cf_message
  | json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", status="status", error_code="error_code"
  | __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
  | app_event=~"auth[.]http[.]request|billing[.]http[.]request"
  | status=~"4[0-9]{2}" | keep app_service, status, error_code
  [$__range]
)))

panels.title: Scheduled task duration
panels.description: Longest completed Auth cleanup or Billing maintenance run per service in the last 10 minutes.

targets.expr:
max_over_time(
  {service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]cleanup|billing[.]maintenance"
  | cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
  | json cf_message="message"
  | line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
  | drop cf_message
  | json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", duration_ms="duration_ms"
  | __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
  | app_event=~"auth[.]cleanup|billing[.]maintenance"
  | keep app_service, duration_ms
  | unwrap duration_ms | __error__=""
  [10m]
) by (app_service)

panels.title: Scheduled task failures
panels.description: Distinct failed runs in the last 15 minutes. Failure events from the same service and request ID count once.

targets.expr:
count by (app_service) (sum by (app_service, app_request_id) (count_over_time(
  {service_name=~".+"} |= ".failure"
  | cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
  | json cf_message="message"
  | line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
  | drop cf_message
  | json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_request_id="request_id"
  | __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
  | app_event=~"auth[.]cleanup[.]failure|billing[.]maintenance[.]failure"
  | app_request_id=~".+" | keep app_service, app_request_id
  [15m]
)))

panels.title: Scheduled task budget exhaustion
panels.description: Runs in the last 15 minutes. Auth reports time or round limits, Billing reports budget_exhausted.

targets.expr:
sum by (app_service) (count_over_time(
  {service_name=~".+"} |~ "auth[.]cleanup|billing[.]maintenance"
  | cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
  | json cf_message="message"
  | line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
  | drop cf_message
  | json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", stop_reason="stop_reason", budget_exhausted="budget_exhausted"
  | __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
  | app_event=~"auth[.]cleanup|billing[.]maintenance"
  | (app_event="auth.cleanup" and stop_reason=~"time_budget|round_limit") or (app_event="billing.maintenance" and budget_exhausted="true")
  | keep app_service
  [15m]
))

panels.title: Request ID across Auth and Billing
panels.description: Enter the exact X-Request-Id above and choose the request time range to see matching application events in order.

targets.expr:
{service_name=~".+"} |= ${request_id:json}
| cloudflare_script_name=~"molis-(auth|billing)-(production|test)"
| json cf_message="message"
| line_format `{{ .cf_message | default (__line__) }}`
| drop cf_message
| json app_service="service", app_env="env", app_event="event", app_request_id="request_id"
| __error__="" | app_service=~"molis-auth|molis-billing" | app_env="${env:raw}"
| app_request_id=~".+" | app_request_id=${request_id:json}
